gaps.explanation: p7 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Modified Cash Basis - Proprietary Funds prints Water Fund and Sewer Fund columns; neither has a schedule, so detail has no business-type lines. Water: Sales 248,399 + Bond proceeds 1,985,000 = 2,233,399; Sewer: Sales 101,814 + Grant income 10,120 = 111,934. 0 + 2,233,399 + 111,934 = 2,345,333 = statement total.
